source_clauses.verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine,
and when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

requirements.observable_verbatim: pressing it should send a signal to the machine

requirements.observable_verbatim: return to its resting position on its own every time

scenarios.name: Pressing to send signal
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the foot pedal. Outside: the workbench, the floor, the machine, and the user's foot.

scenarios.name: Releasing pedal
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the foot pedal. Outside: the workbench, the floor, and the user's foot.

scenarios.name: Sideways brush

freedoms.decision: Specific mechanism for returning to resting position
Specific construction to resist sideways movement

ambiguities.statement: The text does not specify what 'move' means in the context of sideways brushing; it could mean no displacement at all, or no change in position that would affect function.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: during design or by questioning the user

assumptions.statement: The pedal is placed on a horizontal surface (workbench) and the user operates it with their foot.
assumptions.why: The text says workbench and pressing with foot.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the pedal is mounted differently or operated by hand.

assumptions.statement: The machine receives a signal when the pedal is pressed.
assumptions.why: The text says pressing sends a signal to the machine.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the signal is not sent or is sent differently.

assumptions.statement: The pedal returns to its resting position automatically upon release.
assumptions.why: Text says it must return on its own.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If it does not return or requires manual assistance.
